name: Floors route → NOT-CLEAN (floor rejected): stamp the intermediate
description:
The not-clean intermediate, branch 2 of 2 (design R1, group 5). See 06b (dev_from_task_route_not_clean_red) for the full rationale: the not-clean disjunction (measured red OR a structural floor rejected) is split into two GUARDED pure-AND rules so each carries the route.attempt.unclean length_eq 0 self-extinguish guard (a guardless logic:or rule would re-fire and re-append unbounded, since the graph-ingest ADD path bumps the entity version with no nothing-changed skip). This branch fires when a structural FLOOR rejected the attempt even though it may have measured green — the cache-masked-fabrication shape (route.attempt.passed can be true while route.attempt.rejected is true).

TRIGGER = the developer loop L_n: route.attempt.rejected eq "true" (required:false — the scalar exists only on a floors loop) AND route.attempt.unclean length_eq 0 (the self-extinguish guard). Both branches stamp the SAME single-valued route.attempt.unclean='true'; the retry (06c)/escalate (06d) rules read route.attempt.unclean eq 'true'. Mutually exclusive with advance (06a requires route.attempt.rejected=false).

G2: no transition, no spawn — a fact the route RULES compose from.

metadata.station: route not_clean (floor rejected) — the OR-collapse branch 2 (R1, group 5)
metadata.or_collapse: the second guarded AND branch of the not-clean OR-collapse (see 06b). Fires when a structural floor rejected (route.attempt.rejected=true) even on a green measurement (the cache-masked-fabrication shape). Self-extinguishing via route.attempt.unclean length_eq 0.
metadata.self_extinguish: route.attempt.unclean length_eq 0 guard → fire-once; a fresh developer loop L_n per attempt re-arms it.
